reading.zh: 测试文件按「钉住哪件事」分组，顺序与程序实际运行一致：库 → 激活 → 配置（数据根自愈） → 启动 → DLSS5 → 崩溃 → 组件 → 运维，接着是前端的静态回归（菜单动作 / 组件导入 / 新手引导落点），最后是注入开关、单实例与面板注入链路（后者要编译器，没有就 skip）。全部离线：路径都打到临时目录，不碰你真实的游戏目录与 runtime。
reading.en: Test files grouped by the subject they pin down, in the order the program runs: library → activation → config (data-root self-healing) → launch → DLSS5 → crash → components → upkeep, then the static front-end regressions (menu actions / component imports / tour anchors), and finally injection switches, single-instance, and the panel's injection link. Everything is offline: paths are patched into tmp dirs, nothing touches the real game folder or runtime.
